name: The Power of the Dragon
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Choose an Ally from your Life Deck or discard pile and place it in play at 3 stages above 0. Shuffle all Dragon Balls in play owned by your opponent into their Life Deck.

name: Megaton Bull Crusher
modern_rules: Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +X stages. X is the number of Common cards in your discard pile, to a maximum of 10.

name: Orange Energy Smash
modern_rules: Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life cards. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, your opponent cannot perform an energy attack during their next Attacker Attacks phase.

name: Blue Fist Smash
modern_rules: Focused physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +2 stages. HIT: Prevent X stages or life cards of damage from the next attack against this personality this Combat. X is the stages dealt by this attack.

name: Double Teaming
modern_rules: ENDURANCE 2. POWER: Your Main Personality must use this card. For the remainder of Combat, all attacks performed by this personality do +1 stage of damage for each Ally in play.

name: Straining Rebirth Move
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Choose 5, 3, or 1 card from your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck. Your opponent shuffles twice as many cards into their Life Deck. Banish after use.

name: Android 18's Effect
modern_rules: Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life cards. HIT: Capture a Dragon Ball from your opponent.

name: Aura Clash
modern_rules: POWER: You cannot win by Most Powerful Personality Victory for the remainder of the game. Raise your anger 6 levels. Raise your opponent's anger 6 levels.

name: Group Attack
modern_rules: Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. An Ally that has not used this attack this Combat must perform it. This card stays in play to be used 2 more times this Combat. Banish after use.

name: Orange Focused Attack
modern_rules: Focused energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. HIT: Prevent all damage from physical attacks during your opponent's next Attacker Attacks phase.

name: Caught Off Guard Drill
modern_rules: Limit 2 per deck. Heroes only. When played, name a card other than a Personality, Dragon Ball, Sensei, or Mastery. Neither player can play or use that card while this Drill is in play.

name: Vegeta's Anger Drill
modern_rules: Your Setup and Drill cards in your Life Deck without Endurance have ENDURANCE 1 while this Drill is in play.

name: Who's da Man!
modern_rules: ENDURANCE 3. POWER: For the remainder of Combat, play with your hand face up on the table. All your physical attacks do +4 stages of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Dende
modern_rules: Whenever you redirect damage to one of your other Allies, prevent 3 stages of damage from that attack. Dende does not have to take over Combat to use this power.

name: Cell Jr. 1
modern_rules: Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life cards +1 life card for each Cell Jr. you control.

name: Goku's Dragon Ball Quest
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Search your Life Deck for a Dende Dragon Ball that is not currently in play and place it in play.

name: Chazke Village
modern_rules: POWER: When entering Combat, the attacker may search their Life Deck for an Ally and place it in play at 3 stages above 0.

name: Vegeta's Surprised
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Attach to a Main Personality. Banish this card when that personality performs an energy attack. This personality deals a maximum of 5 stages of damage with each physical attack.

name: Gohan's Elbow Block
modern_rules: Stops a physical attack. Search your discard pile for a Gohan named card and place it in your hand. Banish after use.

name: Straining Destruction Move
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Set your Main Personality to 0 stages and banish your discard pile. Your opponent discards the top 5 cards of their Life Deck. Banish after use.

name: Cosmic Backlash
modern_rules: Limit 0 per deck. Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. Your opponent draws 5 cards. HIT: If you did not declare a Tokui-Waza, you win the game.

name: Chiaotzu
modern_rules: Focused energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Dragon's Victory
modern_rules: You must have 4 anger to use this card. POWER: You may raise your opponent's anger 1 level. If your opponent has 4 anger, you win the game.

name: Trunks, the Battler
modern_rules: POWER: When entering Combat as the attacker, you may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Piccolo, the Defender
modern_rules: All your physical attacks do +5 stages of damage.
